citation.title: Clinical performance of implant-assisted removable partial dentures using implant surveyed crowns: a systematic review and meta-analysis
citation.authors: Kim SY, Cho YE, Hong SJ, Huh JB, Pyo SW, Yi Y, Yoo SY

s_design.anchor: Systematic review of retrospective studies and case reports with no pooled analysis performed (THERAPY SR/MA row, 100, via Step 2 routing)
s_design.evidence_quote: This systematic review was conducted according to

domains.note: Absent. Read Methods (PRISMA/PICO, study selection, databases, inclusion criteria, search string, data extraction) and the front matter. No protocol, PROSPERO or registration wording anywhere in the text.

domains.evidence_quote: PubMed, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, and Korea
domains.note: At least 2 bibliographic databases were searched (MEDLINE/PubMed, Cochrane, Web of Science, KCI). The full search string is given in Table 1, and reference lists were also hand-checked.

domains.evidence_quote: A total of 214 articles were obtained.
domains.note: There is no per-study list of excluded full texts. The review reports (a) a screening account with counts and a flowchart (Fig. 1) and (b) explicit inclusion criteria, so the rating is some_concerns under 3b-iii.

domains.domain: risk of bias assessment of included studies
domains.note: Absent. The text states that no appraisal was done: 'Scoping reviews do not examine the possibility of bias or heterogeneity of included studies, hence no quality assessments were undertaken'. Results and Discussion contain no appraisal tool or quality wording.

Absent. Despite the title, Methods (selection → search → data extraction) and Results describe no pooling, effect model, heterogeneity test or statistical analysis of any kind. Findings are only listed narratively by study.
Absent. Methods, Results and Discussion contain no funnel plot, Egger test or publication/small-study bias wording.

penalties.note: The only declaration in the text is a funding line naming the Korean Academy of Prosthodontics, which is an academic society and not a manufacturer. I searched the full text for a conflict-of-interest or competing-interest statement, including ligature variants, and none appears.

penalties.item: no sample size justification / power analysis
penalties.note: not applicable to a secondary study

penalties.item: follow-up shorter than the outcome plausibly requires
penalties.note: The conclusion presents ICRPD as effective as a long-term treatment strategy. The 100% survival figures it summarises rest on implants observed for at least one year, which is short relative to that long-term survival claim.

sources.fact_fa: امتیاز DES این مقاله ۱۹ و باند آن E (سطح زمینه/نظر) برای پرسش از نوع THERAPY است.
sources.interpretation_fa: عنوان مقاله meta-analysis است، اما هیچ تحلیل تجمیعی در آن انجام نشده است. کیفیت مطالعات واردشده هم ارزیابی نشده و ثبت پروتکلی گزارش نشده است. شواهد آن به مطالعات retrospective و case reportهای عمدتاً کره‌ای محدود است. ارزش بالینی آن در حد نقشه‌ای از تجربه‌های موجود درباره‌ی ICRPD است، نه شاهدی برای برتری یا دوام طولانی‌مدت آن.
